title: Custom review rule set
description: A versioned set of custom review rules for one repository. The `rules` array is what the backend stores in `rule_versions.rules`; the backend renders each rule into `<custom_instructions>` as `<rule name="…" include="…" exclude="…">` followed by the numbered checks.

Glob.description: A path glob relative to the repository root (`**`, `*`, `{a,b}` supported). No whitespace: globs are rendered space-separated.

Check.description: One concrete, checkable statement. Numbered at render time; do not number it yourself.

name.description: Unique within the set. Quoted verbatim in the attribution prefix `According to custom instructions in '<rule name>'`, so quotes and angle brackets are not allowed.

include.description: The rule applies to files matching at least one of these globs.

exclude.description: Files matching any of these globs are out of scope even if they match `include`. May be empty.

severity_hint.description: Default severity for findings of this rule; the reviewer may raise or lower it per finding.

version.description: Version of this rule set. A new version is a new file; a file with a version is never edited.
